description: The regarding FILING columns of the child tables sprk_todo, sprk_event, sprk_communication and sprk_analysis (unified-access-control-r2 task 168). This file is the ONE list (owner/main-session round 38). scripts/Lock-CoreAncestorStampColumnsOnForms.ps1 disables the root columns on the forms; scripts/Add-RegardingFilingPickerToForms.ps1 hides the raw filing columns on the forms; src/client/pcf/SpaarkeGridCustomizer (customizers/RootColumnLock.ts) makes both sets not editable in the sprk_event and sprk_analysis grids. All three read this file. Do not copy it anywhere else.
rule: A FILING column is a root column, or a raw filing column. A raw filing column is the record-type column or a pair text column, or a column whose logical name starts with lookupPrefix, whose type is one of lookupTypes, and that is not a root column. Names compare as whole values, case-insensitively: sprk_RegardingMatter matches, sprk_regardingmatterstatus does not match a root. The forms read a column's type from the table's live metadata (AttributeType); the grid reads it from the column definition (dataType). Both use the same type names.
howToExtend: rootColumns is CoreAncestorResolver.CoreAncestorLookups (task 156, src/server). Change it only together with that server list, then re-run both form scripts (dry run, -Apply, -Verify) and rebuild and redeploy SpaarkeGridCustomizer with a version bump.
A new pair column of the ADR-024 regarding pair goes in pairTextColumns (or recordTypeColumn) here, nowhere else.

optionalPairTextColumns names the pairTextColumns the RegardingResolver writes only where the table has them (it binds sprk_regardingrecordnumber only when present). Every OTHER pair column, and recordTypeColumn, is required: Add-RegardingFilingPickerToForms.ps1 refuses a table that lacks one (PAIR_INCOMPLETE, naming it). Each entry must also be in pairTextColumns.
A new sprk_regarding* lookup on a child table needs no edit: the rule covers it by prefix and type.
